stock.description: Huili Resources (Group) Limited functions as an investment holding firm primarily focused on mineral resources within the People's Republic of China, encompassing mining, processing, and sales activities. The company's operations are divided into three core segments: Mining, Trading Business, and Financial Services. The Mining division extracts, processes, and distributes a range of metals including gold, nickel, copper, lead, and zinc, and also holds three valuable exploration permits in Xinjiang province. The Trading segment specializes in the commercial exchange of coal. Furthermore, the Financial Services arm offers various financial provisions. Beyond these, the enterprise also extends its expertise through management and investment consultation, as well as engineering services. Established in 2010, the company rebranded from Realty Resources (Group) Limited to Huili Resources (Group) Limited in May of its founding year. Its corporate base is situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
